confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur price levels, extrapolated to July 2026; no live listings, menus, or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain given wide seasonal and platform variation. Cocktail and wine_glass are set at roughly twice the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. FX not verified: search results were thin and contradictory and included embedded formatting instructions, which were ignored, so the fx fields are null rather than an unverified rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city dataset or source was used. Basis is general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur price levels and its position among Southeast Asian capitals with a similar tourist profile.
